prospects.name: Reeves County A-1
prospects.notes: Tier 1 development well on proven acreage. Low geological risk, high confidence EUR.

prospects.name: Reeves County A-2
prospects.notes: Offset to A-1 on same pad. Similar geology but slightly thinner pay.

prospects.name: Loving County Wildcat
prospects.notes: Exploration well on newly acquired acreage. Higher risk, higher potential. Wide distribution — high uncertainty.

prospects.name: Ward County B-1
prospects.notes: Development well, solid but not spectacular. Mid-tier.

prospects.name: Ward County B-2
prospects.notes: Adjacent to B-1 but with a fault risk that could reduce recovery. Farm-out candidate.

prospects.name: Midland County C-1
prospects.notes: Bread-and-butter Wolfcamp A well. Very predictable. High capital efficiency.

prospects.name: Midland County C-2
prospects.notes: Wolfcamp B bench — deeper, more expensive, higher resource potential.

prospects.name: Martin County D-1
prospects.notes: Older acreage, offset wells show declining performance in this area. Divest candidate in bear case.

prospects.name: Upton County E-1
prospects.notes: LEASE EXPIRING IN 12 MONTHS. Must drill or lose acreage. Mandatory drill due to lease obligation.

prospects.name: Pecos County F-1
prospects.notes: Gas-weighted prospect. Highly sensitive to gas price. Drill in bull gas scenario, defer in base.

prospects.name: Culberson County G-1
prospects.notes: Remote location, 15 miles from nearest pipeline. High infrastructure cost ($5M facility/gathering). Farm-out or defer despite decent resource.

prospects.name: Lea County H-1
prospects.notes: Solid prospect but New Mexico side with higher 25% state royalties. Less attractive than equivalent Texas prospects.

prospects.name: Andrews County I-1
prospects.notes: LEASE EXPIRING IN 14 MONTHS. Mandatory drill. Similar to Upton County E-1.

prospects.name: Winkler County J-1
prospects.notes: High-quality prospect with a $12M acquisition offer on the table. Drill-vs-divest tension.

prospects.name: Crane County K-1
prospects.notes: Average prospect. Budget filler — drilled if budget allows, deferred if not.

methodology: IRR summaries cover only draws with a unique conventional IRR; irr_defined_fraction reports coverage. Payout summaries condition on payout within modeled life; probability_payout_within_life reports coverage.
All monetary values are USD. Gas is priced per MCF; BOE gas volumes use 6 MCF/BOE. No FX conversion is assumed.
P10/P50/P90 use exceedance convention: P10 is the high outcome (90th percentile).
Objective: expected portfolio NPV minus risk aversion times expected loss. Expected loss averages max(-NPV, 0) across all simulated outcomes.
Capital constraints apply to expected upfront capital, including transaction and holding costs, not a worst-case capital guarantee.
Commodity innovations are shared across prospects; resource and cost draws are independent between prospects, with matched draws for alternatives and scenarios.
Retained farm-out interest is a fraction of original WI. Carry applies to retained drilling/completion capital; facilities are not carried.
Defer includes one year of holding cost and no future option value. Divest includes a fixed transaction cost even when closing fails.
NPV uses year-end cash flows and the supplied discount rate. Operating expenses scale with working interest. Taxes apply to positive operating income.
Sensitivity varies one input by +/-20% using matched random draws; it is not a calibrated confidence interval.
Benchmark defaults are illustrative and unverified. Validate assumptions against asset data before an investment decision.
